explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. Mathlib has no Kostant ℤ-form of the universal enveloping algebra and no root-subgroup matrices built from one. The theorem only says that the general library lemma `range_kostantRootSubgroupMatrix_le_upperUnitriangular` applies to the library's own ordered weight basis. All of its content is in those library definitions and lemmas. The only Mathlib object involved is `upperUnitriangularGroup`, which appears just as the target of the inclusion. I judged this from the statement and proof and did not run a search, since none of these constructions exist in Mathlib.
